messages:
maris: kicking off micro-canary for v4-alpha-int4-cal at 1% traffic. primary check: reranker F1 and top-funnel ctr. using SPRT-based gating and a cold-path fallback instead of immediate rollback. ping @luke @devin for signoff.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled -> canary-cluster-3 (variant=v4-alpha-int4-cal) at 2970001234

luke: curious why cold-path vs shrink-first? cold-path means route failing requests to CPU baseline model, right?

devin: yes. idea is preserve telemetry while avoiding user regressions. cold-path routing will dup requests to baseline for scoring and only surface baseline outputs. keeps signal for A/B analysis.

sneh: SPRT params? we should avoid too-many false positives on low-volume slices.

devin: config: sprt_alpha=0.01, sprt_beta=0.05, min_events=500, effect_size_thresholds: reranker_f1=1.2pp, top_ctr=0.4pp. require either metric crossing boundary OR composite bayes_odds>10.

ana: add perf guard: cold-path if p90 latency increase >25ms OR error rate >0.5% for canary group. keep an immediate alert so oncall can intervene.

eval-bot: warm-shadow summary: total=812, reranker_f1 delta=-1.6pp (p=0.008), top_ctr delta=-0.45pp (p=0.04), p90 latency +8ms. bayes_odds=12.4.

maris: that looks like a trigger. executing cold-path switch to preserve signal. command: `ri rollout route-coldpath --variant v4-alpha-int4-cal --set-fraction 0.01`

deploy-bot: cold-path route applied -> canary fraction remains 1%, routed_to_coldpath_fraction=1% at 2970001339

luke: good. please dump the paired request ids and baseline outputs to /eval/pairs/2970001234/ and tag for QA review.

sneh: saving pairs now. also tagging top failing slices: user.query_longtail, reranker.modal_news.

ops-bot: alert created -> #eng-oncall: Reranker F1 dip detected for v4-alpha-int4-cal. severity=low; monitoring.

maris: follow-up plan: keep cold-path for 2 hours, run targeted unit rewrites on 1k failing pairs, run an eval sweep with light-weight prompt-set. if bayes_odds persists >10 after 2 hours -> full rollback.

devin: note for rollout-runbook: add cold-path step and SPRT params as defaults for alpha experiments. also persist sample rate for paired logging.

eval-bot: after 1h window (2970001839): total=2130, reranker_f1 delta=-0.9pp (p=0.09), top_ctr delta=-0.12pp (p=0.32), bayes_odds=3.2.

luke: looks like noise after routing. recommend keep variant in cold-path for 30 more mins then revert to normal routing for a quiet-burn at 0.2% if stable.

maris: will do: `ri rollout route-coldpath --variant v4-alpha-int4-cal --unset` in 30m, then `ri rollout adjust --variant v4-alpha-int4-cal --set-fraction 0.002` for quiet-burn.

ops-bot: note: document incident card /incidents/2970001234 with paired-samples path and initial SPRT snapshot.

maris: unsetting cold-path now at 2970001889 and shrinking to 0.2% quiet-burn. keeping paired logging for 24h.

luke: thanks everyone. lessons: cold-path is a good middle ground to keep signal while protecting users. let's add an automated tag in the UI when cold-path engaged so PMs know outputs may differ. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: final note: resolved for now. will keep artifact for triage.
